def user_home_root: "/" + "Users" + "/";
# A quoted root literal in the archived checker's source is a search pattern,
# not a user's path. Concrete descendants still fail in values and JSON keys.
def has_private_home_path:
  contains(user_home_root) and . != user_home_root and
  (split("\"" + user_home_root + "\"") | join("") |
   split("'" + user_home_root + "'") | join("") | contains(user_home_root));

reduce inputs as $event (
  {schema_version:null,status:null,runtime_commit:null,
   source_status:null,source_commit:null,source_gate_count:null,source_freeze_commit:null,
   invalid_summary_status:0,
   public_cases:0,public_rows:0,focused_cases:0,focused_rows:0,direct_cases:0,direct_rows:0,
   full43_records:0,full43_failed_records:0,full43_complete:false,full43_result_validation:false,
   full43_shared_native_plan_reports:0,full43_shared_native_plan_runs:null,
   public_raw_envelopes:0,focused_raw_envelopes:0,direct_raw_envelopes:0,full43_native_logs:0,
   focused_complete_value_proofs:0,focused_complete_value_rows:0,
   public_complete_value_proofs:0,public_complete_value_rows:0,
   focused_resource_proofs:0,public_resource_proofs:0,
   focused_resource_budget_entries:0,public_resource_budget_entries:0,
   focused_resource_peak_entries:0,public_resource_peak_entries:0,invalid_resource_peaks:0,
   invalid_resource_budgets:0,invalid_resource_peak_fields:0,
   focused_denial_proofs:0,public_denial_proofs:0,
   envelope_fallback_true:0,envelope_field_fallback_true:0,last_envelope_field_key:null,
   invalid_envelope_status:0,private_path_strings:0,
   source_assets:0,unexpected_amendment_fields:0,unexpected_modular_fields:0,
   claim_fallback_true:0,claim_external_engine_true:0,performance_claim_true:0};
  if ($event | length) != 2 then . else
    $event[0] as $p | $event[1] as $v |
    if $p == ["schema_version"] then .schema_version = $v
    elif $p == ["status"] then .status = $v
    elif $p == ["runtime_commit"] then .runtime_commit = $v
    elif $p == ["source_acceptance","status"] then .source_status = $v
    elif $p == ["source_acceptance","source_commit"] then .source_commit = $v
    elif $p == ["source_acceptance","gate_count"] then .source_gate_count = $v
    elif $p == ["source_acceptance","source_freeze","source_commit"] then .source_freeze_commit = $v
    elif $p == ["public","summary","status"] or $p == ["focused_scalars","summary","status"] or $p == ["direct_unary","summary","status"] then
      if $v != "passed" then .invalid_summary_status += 1 else . end
    elif ($p|length) == 5 and $p[1:3] == ["summary","cases"] and $p[4] == "name" then
      if $p[0] == "public" then .public_cases += 1
      elif $p[0] == "focused_scalars" then .focused_cases += 1
      elif $p[0] == "direct_unary" then .direct_cases += 1 else . end
    elif ($p|length) == 5 and $p[1:3] == ["summary","cases"] and $p[4] == "complete_rows_verified" then
      if $p[0] == "public" then .public_rows += $v
      elif $p[0] == "focused_scalars" then .focused_rows += $v
      elif $p[0] == "direct_unary" then .direct_rows += $v else . end
    elif $p == ["full43","summary","complete"] then .full43_complete = $v
    elif $p == ["full43","summary","full_result_validation"] then .full43_result_validation = $v
    elif ($p|length) == 5 and $p[0:3] == ["full43","summary","records"] and $p[4] == "passed" then
      .full43_records += 1 | if $v != true then .full43_failed_records += 1 else . end
    elif $p == ["full43","shared_native_plan_family_verified_runs"] then .full43_shared_native_plan_runs = $v
    elif ($p|length) == 7 and $p[0:2] == ["full43","raw_logs"] and $p[3:5] == ["envelope","fields"] and $p[6] == "value" and $v == "native_vortex_unified_plan" then
      .full43_shared_native_plan_reports += 1
    elif ($p|length) == 4 and $p[0:2] == ["public","complete_value_proofs"] and $p[3] == "kind" then
      .public_complete_value_proofs += 1
    elif ($p|length) == 4 and $p[0:2] == ["public","complete_value_proofs"] and $p[3] == "complete_rows" then
      .public_complete_value_rows += $v
    elif ($p|length) == 4 and $p[0:2] == ["focused_scalars","complete_value_proofs"] and $p[3] == "kind" then
      .focused_complete_value_proofs += 1
    elif ($p|length) == 4 and $p[0:2] == ["focused_scalars","complete_value_proofs"] and $p[3] == "complete_rows" then
      .focused_complete_value_rows += $v
    elif ($p|length) == 4 and ($p[0:2] == ["public","resource_proofs"] or $p[0:2] == ["focused_scalars","resource_proofs"]) and $p[3] == "peak_reserved_bytes" then
      (if $p[0] == "public" then .public_resource_peak_entries += 1 | .public_resource_proofs += 1 else .focused_resource_peak_entries += 1 | .focused_resource_proofs += 1 end) |
      (if ($v|type) != "number" or $v < 0 or $v > (if ($p[2]|contains("-convert-")) then 4 else 1 end) * 1073741824 then .invalid_resource_peaks += 1 else . end)
    elif ($p|length) == 4 and ($p[0:2] == ["public","resource_proofs"] or $p[0:2] == ["focused_scalars","resource_proofs"]) and $p[3] == "budget_gb" then
      (if $p[0] == "public" then .public_resource_budget_entries += 1 else .focused_resource_budget_entries += 1 end) |
      if ($v|type) != "number" or $v != (if ($p[2]|contains("-convert-")) then 4 else 1 end) then .invalid_resource_budgets += 1 else . end
    elif ($p|length) == 4 and ($p[0:2] == ["public","resource_proofs"] or $p[0:2] == ["focused_scalars","resource_proofs"]) and $p[3] == "peak_field" then
      if (["native_vortex_array_sink_peak_reserved_bytes","resident_peak_reserved_buffer_bytes"] | index($v)) == null then .invalid_resource_peak_fields += 1 else . end
    elif ($p|length) == 4 and $p[0:2] == ["public","denial_proofs"] and $p[3] == "sha256" then .public_denial_proofs += 1
    elif ($p|length) == 4 and $p[0:2] == ["focused_scalars","denial_proofs"] and $p[3] == "sha256" then .focused_denial_proofs += 1
    elif ($p|length) == 5 and ($p[1] == "raw_envelopes" or $p[1] == "raw_logs") and $p[3:5] == ["envelope","status"] then
      (if $p[0] == "public" then .public_raw_envelopes += 1
       elif $p[0] == "focused_scalars" then .focused_raw_envelopes += 1
       elif $p[0] == "direct_unary" then .direct_raw_envelopes += 1
       elif $p[0] == "full43" then .full43_native_logs += 1 else . end) |
      if (["success","error","unsupported"] | index($v)) == null then .invalid_envelope_status += 1 else . end
    elif ($p|length) >= 7 and ($p[1] == "raw_envelopes" or $p[1] == "raw_logs") and $p[3] == "envelope" and ($p|index("fields")) != null and $p[-1] == "key" then
      .last_envelope_field_key = $v
    elif ($p|length) >= 7 and ($p[1] == "raw_envelopes" or $p[1] == "raw_logs") and $p[3] == "envelope" and ($p|index("fields")) != null and $p[-1] == "value" then
      .last_envelope_field_key as $field |
      if (($field | type) == "string"
          and (["fallback_attempted","external_engine_invoked","external_query_engine_invoked","fallback_execution_allowed"] | any(. as $suffix | $field | endswith($suffix)))
          and $v != false and $v != "false") then .envelope_field_fallback_true += 1 else . end
    elif ($p|length) == 6 and ($p[1] == "raw_envelopes" or $p[1] == "raw_logs") and $p[3:6] == ["envelope","fallback","attempted"] then
      if $v != false then .envelope_fallback_true += 1 else . end
    elif ($p|length) == 3 and $p[0] == "frozen_source_assets" and $p[2] == "original_sha256" then .source_assets += 1
    elif ($p|length) > 0 and $p[0] == "acceptance_harness_amendment" then .unexpected_amendment_fields += 1
    elif ($p|length) > 0 and $p[0] == "parameterized_public_harness" then .unexpected_modular_fields += 1
    elif $p == ["claim_boundaries","fallback_attempted"] then
      if $v != false then .claim_fallback_true += 1 else . end
    elif $p == ["claim_boundaries","native_external_engine_invoked"] then
      if $v != false then .claim_external_engine_true += 1 else . end
    elif $p == ["claim_boundaries","performance_improvement_claim"] then
      if $v != false then .performance_claim_true += 1 else . end
    else . end |
    if ((($v|type) == "string" and ($v|has_private_home_path)) or (($p|join("/"))|has_private_home_path)) then .private_path_strings += 1 else . end
  end
) | del(.last_envelope_field_key)

"""Independently stream the completed scalar-query packet through jq."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import lzma
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess

OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument('--attempt', required=True)
parser.add_argument('--inspection', required=True)
args = parser.parse_args()
assert args.attempt.isascii() and args.attempt.isdecimal()
assert args.inspection.isascii() and args.inspection.isdecimal()
receipt_path = OUT / f'scalar-final-core-acceptance-{args.attempt}.json'
receipt = json.loads(receipt_path.read_text())
assert receipt['status'] == 'passed_core_local'
assert receipt['performance_claim_allowed'] is False
assert (receipt['public_checks'], receipt['public_rows']) == (23786, 15351524)
assert (receipt['scalar_checks'], receipt['scalar_rows']) == (1128, 2174)
assert (receipt['direct_checks'], receipt['direct_rows']) == (202, 131734)
assert receipt['full43_runs'] == 129
assert (receipt['scalar_resource_proofs'], receipt['scalar_denial_proofs']) == (1018, 110)
assert receipt['new_complete_value_proofs'] == 1018 and receipt['core_local_gates'] == 27
assert receipt['public_raw_envelopes'] > receipt['focused_raw_envelopes'] > 1018
assert Path(receipt['packet']) == OUT / f'native-scalar-subqueries-2026-10-05-attempt-{args.attempt}.json.xz'
packet = Path(receipt['packet'])
with packet.open('rb') as stream:
    assert hashlib.file_digest(stream, 'sha256').hexdigest() == receipt['packet_sha256']
prefix = OUT / f'scalar-packet-inspection-{args.inspection}'
query = OUT / 'inspect_scalar_packet_v2.jq'
command = ['/usr/bin/jq', '--stream', '-n', '-f', str(query)]
with prefix.with_suffix('.counters.json').open('x') as output, \
        prefix.with_suffix('.stderr.txt').open('x') as error:
    process = subprocess.Popen(command, stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=output, stderr=error)
    try:
        with lzma.open(packet, 'rb') as source:
            for chunk in iter(lambda: source.read(1024 * 1024), b''):
                process.stdin.write(chunk)
        process.stdin.close()
        assert process.wait(timeout=30) == 0
    finally:
        if process.poll() is None:
            process.kill()
            process.wait()
counters = json.loads(prefix.with_suffix('.counters.json').read_text())
expected = {
    'schema_version': 'shardloom.native_scalar_subqueries_acceptance.v1',
    'status': 'passed_core_local',
    'runtime_commit': receipt['runtime_commit'],
    'source_status': 'passed_core_source',
    'source_commit': receipt['runtime_commit'],
    'source_freeze_commit': receipt['runtime_commit'],
    'source_gate_count': 27,
    'invalid_summary_status': 0,
    'public_cases': 23786,
    'public_rows': 15351524,
    'focused_cases': 1128,
    'focused_rows': 2174,
    'direct_cases': 202,
    'direct_rows': 131734,
    'full43_records': 129,
    'full43_failed_records': 0,
    'full43_complete': True,
    'full43_result_validation': True,
    'full43_shared_native_plan_reports': 129,
    'full43_shared_native_plan_runs': 129,
    'public_raw_envelopes': receipt['public_raw_envelopes'],
    'focused_raw_envelopes': receipt['focused_raw_envelopes'],
    'direct_raw_envelopes': counters['direct_raw_envelopes'],
    'full43_native_logs': 129,
    'focused_complete_value_proofs': 1018,
    'focused_complete_value_rows': 2174,
    'public_complete_value_proofs': 1018,
    'public_complete_value_rows': 2174,
    'focused_resource_proofs': 1018,
    'public_resource_proofs': 1018,
    'focused_resource_budget_entries': 1018,
    'public_resource_budget_entries': 1018,
    'focused_resource_peak_entries': 1018,
    'public_resource_peak_entries': 1018,
    'invalid_resource_peaks': 0,
    'invalid_resource_budgets': 0,
    'invalid_resource_peak_fields': 0,
    'focused_denial_proofs': 110,
    'public_denial_proofs': 110,
    'envelope_fallback_true': 0,
    'envelope_field_fallback_true': 0,
    'invalid_envelope_status': 0,
    'private_path_strings': 0,
    'source_assets': 901,
    'unexpected_amendment_fields': 0,
    'unexpected_modular_fields': 0,
    'claim_fallback_true': 0,
    'claim_external_engine_true': 0,
    'performance_claim_true': 0,
}
differences = {key: {'observed': counters[key], 'expected': value}
               for key, value in expected.items() if counters[key] != value}
assert not differences, differences
assert counters['direct_raw_envelopes'] > 202
assert counters['public_raw_envelopes'] > counters['focused_raw_envelopes']
result = {
    'status': 'passed',
    'packet_sha256': receipt['packet_sha256'],
    'independent_parser': subprocess.check_output(
        ['/usr/bin/jq', '--version'], text=True).strip(),
    'query_sha256': hashlib.sha256(query.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
    'inspector_sha256': hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
    'counters': counters,
    'runtime_executed': False,
    'performance_claim': False,
}
with prefix.with_suffix('.json').open('x') as stream:
    json.dump(result, stream, indent=2)
    stream.write('\n')
print(json.dumps(result, indent=2), flush=True)

"""Check the independent parser's execution-policy field selection."""
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess

OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
QUERY = OUT/'inspect_scalar_packet_v2.jq'

def scan(query, family, fields):
    raw = 'raw_logs' if family == 'full43' else 'raw_envelopes'
    payload = {family: {raw: [{'envelope': {'fields': fields}}]}}
    return json.loads(subprocess.check_output(
        ['/usr/bin/jq', '--stream', '-n', '-f', str(query)],
        input=json.dumps(payload), text=True))['envelope_field_fallback_true']

normal = [{'key': 'native_rows', 'value': '12'}]
cases = []
for family in ('public', 'focused_scalars', 'direct_unary', 'full43'):
    for suffix in ('fallback_attempted', 'external_engine_invoked',
                   'external_query_engine_invoked', 'fallback_execution_allowed'):
        for value, expected in ((False, 0), ('false', 0), (True, 1), ('true', 1),
                                (0, 1), (None, 1)):
            fields = [*normal, {'key': f'public_workflow_{suffix}', 'value': value},
                      {'key': 'native_plan_family', 'value': 'native_vortex_unified_plan'}]
            observed = scan(QUERY, family, fields)
            assert observed == expected, (family, suffix, value, observed, expected)
            cases.append({'family': family, 'field': suffix, 'value': value,
                          'expected': expected, 'observed': observed})
    assert scan(QUERY, family, normal) == 0
private_path_cases = []
root_marker = '/' + 'Users' + '/'
path_fixtures = [
    ('generic_root', {'value': root_marker}, 0),
    ('quoted_generic_root', {'value': 'contains("' + root_marker + '")'}, 0),
    ('single_quoted_generic_root', {'value': "contains('" + root_marker + "')"}, 0),
    ('concrete_path', {'value': root_marker + 'example/project'}, 1),
    ('unicode_user', {'value': root_marker + '\u7528\u6237/project'}, 1),
    ('spaced_user', {'value': root_marker + 'Example User/project'}, 1),
    ('quoted_concrete_path', {'value': 'open("' + root_marker + 'example/file")'}, 1),
    ('single_quoted_concrete_path', {'value': "open('" + root_marker + "example/file')"}, 1),
    ('concrete_key', {root_marker + 'example/project': False}, 1),
    ('source_with_concrete_path', {'source': 'contains("' + root_marker + '"); open("' + root_marker + 'example/file")'}, 1),
    ('original_inspector_source', {'source': (OUT/'inspect_scalar_packet.jq').read_text()}, 0),
    ('revised_inspector_source', {'source': QUERY.read_text()}, 0),
]
for name, payload, expected in path_fixtures:
    observed = json.loads(subprocess.check_output(
        ['/usr/bin/jq', '--stream', '-n', '-f', str(QUERY)],
        input=json.dumps(payload), text=True))['private_path_strings']
    assert observed == expected, (name, observed, expected)
    private_path_cases.append({'name': name, 'expected': expected, 'observed': observed})

"""Locate every private-path marker with bounded decompression memory."""
import json
import lzma
from pathlib import Path

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
packet = root / 'native-scalar-subqueries-2026-10-05-attempt-2.json.xz'
needle = b'/Users/'
tail = b''
total = 0
matches = []
with lzma.open(packet, 'rb') as source:
    for chunk in iter(lambda: source.read(1024 * 1024), b''):
        window = tail + chunk
        base = total - len(tail)
        at = 0
        while (at := window.find(needle, at)) >= 0:
            offset = base + at
            if not matches or offset > matches[-1]['offset']:
                matches.append({
                    'offset': offset,
                    'context': window[max(0, at - 400):at + 400].decode('utf-8', errors='replace'),
                })
            at += len(needle)
        total += len(chunk)
        tail = window[-1024:]
result = {'uncompressed_bytes': total, 'matches': matches}
with (root / 'scalar-packet-private-path-diagnosis-report-1.json').open('x') as stream:
    json.dump(result, stream, indent=2)
    stream.write('\n')
print(json.dumps(result, indent=2))
